name: Gobbler Punch
description: Bourbon, orange, cranberry and brown-sugar-cinnamon syrup with lemon and a dash of Angostura, lengthened with ginger beer. Mix the base at home and pour it into a drink dispenser when you get there.
history: A house punch for carrying to someone else’s Thanksgiving: one bottle of bourbon, juice from the store, and the cinnamon syrup already in the fridge.
whyItWorks: Orange and cranberry make the sour, the cinnamon syrup the sweet and the spice, and ginger beer gives it the length and bite of a punch without a second bottle.
ice: Large block in the dispenser; cubes in the glass
steps: Scale to the guest count. At home, stir the bourbon, juices, syrup and bitters together in a jug or bottles and chill overnight.
On site, pour the base into a glass drink dispenser over a block of ice and add the ginger beer.
Float orange wheels, and pour over cubes in each glass.
techniqueNotes: For 12: 18 oz bourbon (most of a 750 ml), 12 oz each orange and cranberry, 6 oz each syrup and lemon, 12 dashes Angostura; two 12 oz cans of ginger beer on site.
Freeze a loaf pan of water the day before for the block; it melts far slower than cubes.

recommendedBottles.rationale: A good mixing bourbon for a crowd.
